topics.label: Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer frames the session by linking it to histopathology practicals and setting out the core learning outcomes for the lecture.

topics.label: Viral Transformation and Discovery of Cellular Oncogenes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how the investigation of transforming tumor viruses led to the discovery of cellular proto-oncogenes and the experimental assays used to demonstrate cell transformation.

topics.label: Classification and Functional Mechanics of Oncogenes and Tumor Suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer-associated mutations are classified and how specific alterations in oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes disrupt cell cycle checkpoints and cellular phenotype.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Progression Dynamics of Genetic Instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the cellular failures that generate sequence and chromosomal instability and explain how this instability drives the multistep progression of tumors.

topics.label: Hereditary Cancer Predispositions and Tumor Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how inherited germline mutations accelerate cancer development in predisposition syndromes and how tumor evolution can alter a cancer's ongoing dependence on genetic instability.

topics.label: Conclusion and Further Reading
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the lecture with a summary review, recommended reading, and a preview of the next topic.
